Card Q&A.a: Only the player of those cards can search/look at them.  The opponent player can't search/look at them.
Card Q&A.q: Can I search/look at face-down cards under a Tamer?

Card Q&A.a: It's placed face-up in the trash.
Card Q&A.q: What happens if a face-down card under a Tamer is trashed?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand or placing it face down under any of your [Keenan Crier]s, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] Your opponent trashes 1 card in their hand.
